title: skilus · The package manager for AI agent skills
description: Install AI agent skills from GitHub, any Git repository, archives or local folders into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 70 more agents. Enhanced security: every skill is pinned, hashed and inspected before it runs.
h1: The package manager for AI agent skills
lead: Install skills from GitHub, any Git repository, an archive or a local folder into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and {more} more agents. **Enhanced security**: every skill is pinned to a commit, hashed and inspected before your agent can run it.
recording: Recording of skilus in a terminal
whatText: skilus is a single Go binary that installs the SKILL.md skills your AI agents use and keeps a record of exactly what was installed. It works like a package manager: `skilus.yaml` says what you want and `skilus.lock` says what you got.
features: Every skill is locked to a commit and a SHA-256 in `skilus.lock`
Escaping symlinks, `curl | sh`, credential access and hidden text are caught before install
`skilus sync` rebuilds the same setup on any machine or CI runner, like `npm ci`
GitHub, any Git host, ZIP or tar.gz archives and local folders, with your own Git credentials
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and more
Switch between skill sets for each context with one command
Prompts, messages and help in your own language
dlLead: {version} · One binary for macOS, Linux and Windows, with nothing else to install. Every release is signed and comes with checksums and an SBOM.
terminalText: The script picks the binary for your system, checks it against `checksums.txt` and puts it on your PATH.
binText: Unpack the archive and move `skilus` to a folder on your PATH.
verifyText: Releases are signed with Sigstore by the GitHub Actions workflow that built them. With `cosign` installed, run this in the folder where you downloaded the files:
agentsText: skilus finds the agents installed on your machine and copies each skill into the folder that agent reads.
